fusions.name: Edge in the Cloud
fusions.desc: A hidden cut that deals 18 damage, consuming every affliction you have on the target and dealing 60% more for each one, then leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Thousand Small Cuts
fusions.desc: Flicks 3 razor-winged locusts at once, spread apart, each one dealing 3 damage, with a 25% chance per hit to leave the target [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Lost in the Swarm
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds, moving 10% faster. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Unseen Mandibles
fusions.desc: Your critical hit chance rises by 10%.
